app: proyecto-final

service: api-compras

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: python3.12
  timeout: 30
  stage: ${opt:stage}        
  iam:
    role: arn:aws:iam::659277875740:role/LabRole

custom:
  tableName: t_compras-${self:provider.stage}

functions:
  create:
    name: CreateCompra
    handler: Lambda_CrearCompra.lambda_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /compra/create
          method: post
          cors: true
          integration: lambda-proxy
          request:
            parameters:
              headers:
                Authorization: true

  list:
    name: ListCompras
    handler: Lambda_ListarCompras.lambda_handler
    events:
      - http:
          path: /compra/list
          method: post
          cors: true
          integration: lambda-proxy
          request:
            parameters:
              headers:
                Authorization: true

resources:
  Resources:
    ComprasTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: t_compras
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: tenant_id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: sort_id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: tenant_id
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: sort_id
            KeyType: RANGE
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
